class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><b><span style="font-size: 13.5pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">User</span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Represents a person using the HBnB application. Users can register, update their profile, own places, and write reviews. A user can be an administrator.</span></p><div class="MsoNormal" align="center" style="margin: 0cm; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;"><hr size="0" width="100%" align="center"></span></div><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><b><span style="font-size: 13.5pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Place</span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Represents a property listed on the platform. Each place belongs to a user and can have multiple amenities and reviews.</span></p><div class="MsoNormal" align="center" style="margin: 0cm; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;"><hr size="0" width="100%" align="center"></span></div><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><b><span style="font-size: 13.5pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Review</span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Represents feedback left by a user for a place. Each review is associated with one user and one place.</span></p><div class="MsoNormal" align="center" style="margin: 0cm; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;"><hr size="0" width="100%" align="center"></span></div><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><b><span style="font-size: 13.5pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Amenity</span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: normal; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;">Represents features that can be associated with places, such as Wi-Fi or parking. Amenities can be shared between multiple places.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 8pt; line-height: 18.4px; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-align: start;">&nbsp;</p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="630" x="110" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
